component.name: Sniffile
component.summary: Fast local file search that never leaves your machine

description.p: Sniffile indexes the folders you choose and finds files by name, folder, date, extension, image orientation and the text inside plain-text files. It understands Russian and English queries, survives typos and works completely offline.
The desktop app is a single small binary with a native window. Optional photo captions and query expansion can use a local ollama instance; no data is ever sent to a cloud service.
First tagged release. Phone photos are rotated from EXIF, Windows reveal selects the file in Explorer, and path checks are case-insensitive on Windows.
Native desktop packaging for Linux and Windows, faster startup, Wayland fix.
